note: api_id 2040 is Telegram Desktop's published pair: the credential probe showed it is accepted by Telegram but not proven to survive a real login. Replace both values here once you have your own app from my.telegram.org; nothing else has to change.
note_ai: Free-plan OpenRouter key lives in the repository secret OPENROUTER_API_KEY (repo settings → Secrets → Actions), never in this file: GitHub push protection rejects committed keys, and a secret is also readable by the workflow without being public. AI_MODEL=auto asks /models which free models exist and picks one, then falls back through the rest; free slugs rotate monthly, which is why the model is not pinned. `python -m havoc ai` makes one real call to verify.
